title: Dudley Lamming
extract: Dudley Lamming is an American pathologist and biomedical researcher. He is vice chair for biomedical research in the Department of Medicine at the University of Wisconsin-Madison and is co-director of the Wisconsin Nathan Shock Center of Excellence in the Basic Biology of Aging. He has served as the elected president of the American Aging Association and is an elected fellow of the AAA and the Gerontological Society of America
